column4: a differential oracle that compares two paths of the same class (fromOwners vs the staged Builder) only guards the members where the paths diverge; a member both paths share (payloadBytes) can change without a failure, so a mutant set needs at least one SURVIVE row naming that gap instead of claiming full refusal
